notes: Sub-study: this document is an intervention-specific appendix (ISA) to a master protocol. Page 1 (cover sheet) does not name the master; the title page (p2) does, verbatim: "Master Protocol Title: A Master Protocol for Randomized, Placebo-Controlled, Phase 2 Clinical Trials of Multiple Interventions for the Treatment of Chronic Pain" / "Master Protocol Number: H0P-MC-CPMP". Master identifier as printed: H0P-MC-CPMP (CPMP); OA disease-state addendum H0P-MC-CPMP(1). Nothing was filled from the master. Deferrals to the master: p11 SoA note "Please refer to master protocol H0P-MC-CPMP (CPMP) and the osteoarthritis (OA) disease-state addendum (DSA) H0P-MC-CPMP(1) SoAs for additional information."; p34 lab tests "The master protocol CPMP describes tests that may be performed at additional times noted in the SoA for this ISA" - so analytes for SoA rows Hematology, Urinalysis, Urine drug screen and Hemoglobin A1c (and any Chemistry analytes beyond Cystatin-C) are not given here; p12 SoA note for Rescue medication usage reporting, NRS, PGI, WOMAC refers to the CPMP SoA; instruments NRS, PGI, WOMAC, C-SSRS and the Self-Harm forms are not described here beyond SoA names, abbreviation expansions and the items recorded (p18: participants "will report their experience using standard tools" as part of Study CPMP); objectives/endpoints (p8, p19), eligibility (p22), discontinuation (p27), assessments timing (p28), statistics and populations (p31-32) and immunogenicity sample retention (p30: "protocol CPMP, Appendix 1, Section 10.1.12") defer to CPMP/CPMP(1). SoA rows not described in the text beyond the SoA row: Weight, Adverse events, Concomitant medication, Rescue medication usage reporting, Hematology, Urinalysis, Urine drug screen, Hemoglobin A1c, Study intervention IV infusion (described in 6.1, p24, as dosing, not an assessment). Conflicts: physical examination components - SoA note p12 says "mouth", section 8.1.1 p28 prints "month" (both recorded). Urine pregnancy population - SoA note p13 "all premenopausal females or postmenopausal females <50 years of age" vs Appendix 2 p35 "Women of child-bearing potential" (serum test at screening, urine test within 24 hours prior to exposure); both recorded. Rule 10: the lab-tests table (p34) was read from the page image; the text layer interleaves the three columns. Image confirms Chemistry = Cystatin-C (plus a stray '.' cell, ignored); Urine Chemistries = Albumin, Creatinine, ACR, Protein, PCR; Other Tests = Immunogenicity, Epiregulin, LY3016859 concentration, Urine pregnancy. No page lacks a text layer. Rule 11: the PDF holds one version only, Amendment (a) (approved 27-Mar-2020); the SoA (p11-14) is from it. The amendment summary (p4-5) describes changes from the Original Protocol (30 January 2020), which is not in the PDF. Abbreviations: there is no stand-alone abbreviation list; abbreviations are taken from the lines printed under the schema (p10), SoA (p14), risk table (p17), objectives table (p19), intervention table (p24), the lab-tests table (p34) and the SoA heading note (p11). Token in SoA activity names not defined by any of these: 'A1c' (Hemoglobin A1c). cross_references: the SoA inputs have no soa_cross_references, so the list is empty. Specimen for the lab panels is not stated on p34 (only Urine Chemistries / Urine pregnancy imply urine by name), so panel specimen is null. Section 8.6 is redacted (CCI). Updated 2026-11-07 to schema 1.1 (no re-extraction): instruments carry kind.
